title: animatic 01 · the dissonant frequencies — cold open (0:00–3:00)
note: Provisional board→plate assignment. Boards come from manga pass 01 · pages 1–2 (panels 1.1–2.3) per animatic-01-the-dissonant-frequencies.md. Plates are the sandbox-slates-v1 picks; as episode plates land they replace the picks 1:1 — the timecodes stay the boss.

boards.action: Rain-slicked crossing, neon smeared, cooling towers steaming. Slow push in. (four-four enters alone, no reverb tail)
Drift up the tower face; droplets sync to the hi-hat. (four-four + rain foley, still dry)
The basement door, sliver of club light; ITO flips the sign. (four-four at full body; door thud cuts it soft)
Up the clinic stairs: pumps, dark glass, one amber lamp over the hatch. (city fades to pumps; the four-four goes below the mix)
Elias at the hatch; coat off, no ceremony. A hand on the rim, an exhale. (pumps + a single breath)
Into the water; the lid takes the ceiling. Bubbles scatter the ruler-lines. (water gulp, then under-mix quiet: the four-four now inside the body)
The descent begins; the ocean's first glow arrives from below. (slow tide of wave synthesis, no melody)
Title card, waveform glyph: EPISODE 01 — THE DISSONANT FREQUENCIES. (one clean creek note, then cut)
